notes: Ma'bad speaks in the first person («قال اجتمعنا ناس») about a visit to Anas. The chain is read to Anas, who speaks («فقال حدثنا محمد»): a first-person narrative with implicit transmission, so flagged.
Thabit is a speaker in the scene, not a link. The later «حدثني» of al-Hasan, a further isnad for the same saying, is not read as a route.
